door-cuddlecore.label: Cuddlecore
door-cuddlecore.blurb: Gentle food for days you're not at your best

front-door.label: Exit out the front door
front-door.leaving: Off out? Mind the step, love.

stairs.label: Up the stairs
stairs.moment: Upstairs is the library and the turret. They're not open yet, and the guest rooms are all taken.
moments: I hear someone up there sometimes. Probably the pipes.
The fourth step creaks. I have decided it is a signal.

cellar-door.label: The cellar door
cellar-door.moment: It's stiff. It's been stiff for years.
moments: I've put a chair against it. It still won't stay shut.
I'm told the cellar's lovely. I'll take their word.

groceries.label: Your shopping
groceries.ref: the shopping by the front door

notice-board.label: The notice board
notice-board.moment: What's in season, the soup of the day, and anything I pin up for you. Nothing pinned yet.

sea-window.label: The sea
sea-window.moment: The same bay you can see from Cuddlecore.
moments: Stand here long enough and you can hear the water.
Some days the bay looks painted on.

noticeboard._when: The hallway notice board: touching it says the line for the visitor's hemisphere and season, and serves one of its ideas.

spring.line: Asparagus is in, and the first strawberries. Rhubarb too.

summer.line: Tomatoes, sweetcorn and stone fruit are in. Passionfruit too.

autumn.line: Feijoas are in, and the first kūmara.

winter.line: Tamarillos, mandarins and silverbeet are in.
